gen-gf-goldman-gf-mitr: Widely spaced, parenthesis-round letters give Goldman its commanding look. Mitr sits underneath, contemporary and approachable, its lowercase almost as tall as its capitals, which keeps the bold heading from towering over the text.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-momo-trust-display: Goldman's wide-set letters and parenthesis-round curves give the heading a bold, commanding stance. Momo Trust Display drifts along beneath, its loose spacing and generous x-height making a long block of text feel clean and unhurried.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-mukta: Commanding from the first word, Goldman sets round, wide letters up top. Mukta's tall-bodied lowercase keeps paragraphs feeling clean and unobtrusive, easy to move through line after line without a snag.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-mukta-mahee: Wide, round and commanding, Goldman runs its parenthesis-like curves across the top, above the chunky, tall lowercase of Mukta Mahee. One announces, the other keeps the mood friendly and clean.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-mukta-malar: Goldman's wide, generous letter spacing and parenthesis-round curves give the heading a commanding presence before Mukta Malar arrives. Beneath it, Mukta Malar feels compact, neutral and approachable by comparison.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-mukta-vaani: Mukta Vaani brings a high-waisted lowercase and a contemporary, level-headed manner to the text. Mukta Vaani is best at quiet, steady reading, while Goldman's wide, round letters are best at making an entrance.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-narnoor: Bold, wide-set Goldman leads with round forms that read like open parentheses. But Narnoor, short-ascendered with big bowls, is professional and measured, and that gap in temperament is what makes the pairing click.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-display: Noto Sans Display feels friendly on the page, its big, tall middle zone filling out every word under Goldman's heading. Display swagger meets quiet legibility, and that is the draw.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-play: Clean-cut Play sits beneath Goldman's wide-set, parenthesis-round heading. Play keeps a faint weight difference between upstrokes and downstrokes and little height gap between cases, so paragraphs glide along without effort.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-port-lligat-sans: Port Lligat Sans packs its characters tight as pins in a cushion, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Goldman is built to announce, Port Lligat Sans to carry the detail.
